subject: Tracking: Kestrel Systems PO issuance + spend-cap mismatch (line-item corrections needed)
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@kestrel-sys.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@kestrel-sys.com
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Missing PO# and spend cap on onboarding form

Hi Aditya,

We're finishing the last steps of our vendor intake forms and noticed the provisional onboarding packet from Redwood doesn't include an assigned PO number. The finance team at Kestrel needs a PO# to map spend to our cost center, and the spend cap in the packet (USD 65,000) doesn't match our negotiated figure (USD 50,000).

A couple of line-item questions: the SKU breakdown shows three line items but one (AI-inference credits) is split across two codes in your sheet — that will cause trouble for our AP. Can you confirm:
- When will the official PO number be assigned?
- Can the spend cap be adjusted to USD 50,000 and reflected on the PO?
- Can you provide a cleaned line-item file with consolidated SKU for the inference credits?

We're on a timebox — billing needs the finalized PO by EOD Tuesday to hit our fiscal cutoff. Any chance to expedite?

Thanks,
Evan Brooks
Head of Procurement
Kestrel Systems
[attachment: kestrel_onboard_packet.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@kestrel-sys.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Missing PO# and spend cap on onboarding form

Hi Evan — thanks for flagging this. Short answers up front: we can assign an official PO number this week, and we can align the spend cap to the USD 50,000 you negotiated. I put Monica (procurement ops) and Rishi (billing) on copy to coordinate the PO issuance and ledger mapping.

Action plan I propose now:
1) Monica to generate a provisional PO number and submit it to finance for formal issuance.
2) Rishi to confirm how the spend-cap change will affect the accounting code and any proration.
3) Stephanie will produce an updated line-item spreadsheet with AI-inference credits consolidated into a single SKU and a clean mapping for AP.

Monica — can you start the PO draft and set priority to "expedite"? Evan — I'll ping you as soon as we have the PO# so you can route it to your AP.

Aditya
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@kestrel-sys.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Missing PO# and spend cap on onboarding form

Hi team — starting the PO process now. Notes:
- I'll reserve provisional PO 000789-PROV and mark it as expedited. If finance clears it, the final PO will be PO-789 and I'll push a signed PDF.
- Rishi: I need confirmation whether changing spend cap to 50k requires any internal approvals (legal/discount recalc) or if procurement can proceed under existing onboarding terms.

Evan — attaching an initial line-item cleanup (lineitems_kestrel_fix_v1.xlsx) with the inference credits merged under SKU RED-INF-C. Please review and let us know if Kestrel needs different SKU naming.

Two small clarifications for AP mapping:
- Should we map PO to Kestrel cost center: KES-IT-02 (as listed)?
- Do you require net-30 or net-45 terms on the invoice?

I'll follow up with the formal PO PDF once finance stamps it.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Procurement Operations — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
[attachment: lineitems_kestrel_fix_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@kestrel-sys.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Missing PO# and spend cap on onboarding form

Quick update from finance: changing the spend cap to USD 50,000 is fine from our side; no additional legal approvals required because the discount and pricing were already approved in the SOW. We'll record the cap change as an amendment to the onboarding memo and it will reflect on the final PO.

Monica — proceed with PO-789 issuance. Accounting note: because the Kestrel fiscal cutoff is this Tuesday, we'll mark invoice acceptance "as of PO issue" and allow one off-cycle billing if needed, but please flag any invoices that attempt to bill beyond the new cap.

Also: Monica/Stephanie, please ensure the final line-item sheet includes a single consolidated code for inference credits and a subtotal line that ties to the cap so AP can validate quickly.

Rishi
Finance — Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@kestrel-sys.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 15:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: PO issued (PO-789) + attached corrected line items

Evan — thanks for the patience. Final status: PO-789 has been issued and signed by finance (attached: kestrel_po_789-draft.pdf). Spend cap updated to USD 50,000 and reflected on the PO. Stephanie attached the cleaned line-item workbook (lineitems_kestrel_fix_v2.xlsx) with:
- AI-inference credits consolidated under RED-INF-C (single SKU)
- Line-level totals that roll up to the PO cap
- Vendor-friendly SKU labels for Kestrel AP

Next steps for Kestrel AP:
1) Confirm cost center mapping KES-IT-02 or provide alternate.
2) Confirm invoice term (net-30 preferred from Redwood side) or tell us if you require net-45.
3) If everything looks good, route PO-789 to your AP for processing.

If you need us to push the PO into your vendor portal, we can also do that — share portal write-access or a contact and Monica will upload.

Aditya
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[attachment: kestrel_po_789-draft.pdf (application/pdf)]
